t: This is Bond Street tube station, an interchange for the London Underground and the Elizabeth line, in Mayfair in the West End. There are entrances on Oxford Street, near its junction with New Bond Street, and on Hanover Square. The architect Harry Bell Measures, who lived from 1862 to 1940, designed the station. The British property developer Paul Castle, who lived from 1950 to 2010, died here.
